name: Barracks block
description: Two-storey modern barracks, 30 x 11 m: grey brick ground floor and precast panel upper floor with a dark floor band, many punched windows (each an opening sash), a glazed double front door under a steel canopy, a rear door, a central switchback stair core and a central corridor on both floors. Ground floor: entry hall, day room, washroom and five dormitories; upper floor: washroom and eight dormitories. Flat roof with parapet, plant and a small mast.
